description: This file contains C++ source code for the PyTorch JIT Python IR, including class and function definitions, bindings with pybind11, and internal logic for handling Python operations within the JIT compiler.

classes.name: ConcretePythonOp
classes.description: Represents a Python operation node in the JIT graph, encapsulating a Python object and related metadata.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a computational graph in the JIT compiler, with methods for graph manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the JIT graph, with methods for inspecting and modifying node properties.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a value (tensor, scalar, etc.) in the JIT graph.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a block of nodes within a graph or node.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Base class for various data types in the JIT type system.

classes.name: AliasDb
classes.description: Alias analysis database for tracking value aliasing within a graph.

classes.name: ShapeComputeGraphMapping
classes.description: Mapping for shape computation within the graph for shape analysis.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the Python name of the Python operation.

methods.name: autogradFunction
methods.description: Recovers the autograd.Function instance if available.

methods.name: writeScalars
methods.description: Outputs scalar arguments to a stream.

methods.name: lint_python
methods.description: Performs internal consistency checks on the Python operation node.

methods.name: createPythonOp
methods.description: Creates a new Python operation node in the graph.
